correctness.rationale: Exact central difference and Wick fourth moments imply Q_{k+1}=cQ_k+eta^2 tr(Sigma Q_k)Sigma^{-1}; trace-Sigma closure yields equation (1) for all integer k>=0. Convex inversion plus averaging under O(r)xO(d-r) proves reduction over every SPD covariance; elementary minimization of affine t plus reciprocal t yields all band regimes. The strictly positive leading L^k coefficient and explicit Lambda<1 condition prove the rate result.

value.rationale: Globally solves a natural uncertainty-aware covariance-design problem for every dimension, subspace rank and nondegenerate alignment band, and for every positive finite iteration horizon. The sharp threshold r/d determines when hints improve worst-case moment prefactors, while an invariant leading exponent rules out a claimed rate gain. Provides an interpretable, motivated benchmark for directional-hint zeroth-order methods rather than an arbitrary sample calculation.
